💡 PdfDing | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: Self-hosted management, viewing, and editing of PDF documents across multiple devices.
✨ Key Features: • Browser-based PDF viewing with position memory • Workspaces, collections, multi-level tagging, starring, and archiving • PDF editing (text, highlighting, drawings) • Signature addition • Export of highlights and comments
📖 Summary: PdfDing is a self-hosted PDF management, viewing, and editing solution designed for seamless cross-device access. It offers features like workspaces, tagging, highlighting, and SSO, all accessible through a clean, intuitive web interface.
